name: MuseScore
title: MuseScore: free Sibelius alternative
hook: Sibelius charges you ninety nine bucks a year to write sheet music on your computer. This app does it for free.

features.say: Click notes onto the page, or play them in with a MIDI keyboard.
Hit play and it plays your whole score back. Then save it as a PDF.

caption:
Sibelius Artist charges $99/year. MuseScore lets you write and play back sheet music on your computer for free 🎼

✅ Click notes in, or use a MIDI keyboard
✅ Plays your score back with a built-in mixer
✅ Imports and exports MusicXML and MIDI, saves PDFs
✅ No subscription, no limits, 100% free

💻 Mac · Windows · Linux
ℹ️ The app and its free MuseSounds Core instruments cost nothing. Extra premium sound libraries are optional and paid

Comment "MUSIC" and I'll DM you the link 🔗
